note: Every signal a catalogue element may cite. A signal is something Daylight Commons can show from the page or from a receipt. Signals in the same family read the same evidence and count once. Context-only signals never evidence any element.

signals.observes: Reposts per like far above the author's own posts seen on this device.
Groups of sampled bios cut from one template.
A large share of sampled bios combine stock persona cues.
Many sampled accounts joined within the same 14 days.
Sampled bios are dominated by a topic the post does not share.
Quote posts without a Paid partnership label share a template with labelled ones, or with each other inside two hours.
Sampled accounts were seen amplifying two or more other launches the viewer opened.
Quote posts carry X's Paid partnership label, the posters' own disclosure.
Quote posts use promotional template phrasing.
The viewer opened the launch lens on this post, or quotes carry promotional phrasing or a Paid partnership label.
The platform discloses the launch account as an organisation or official account.
The conduct is a post published on an online platform.
Quote posts arrived close together in time. Needs times to the minute; with coarser times it is not observable at this time precision and never shows.

Several accounts replied within seconds, tighter than the thread's pace explains. Needs times to the second; times worked out from rounded ages such as 14h or 1d share one second by construction, so with coarser times it is not observable at this time precision and never fires.
Some sampled accounts were seen on other launches, below the indicator threshold.
Handles ending in a number-and-letter tail. People choose these for privacy too.
A search link to an advertiser's entries in a public ad repository, opened by the user.
